# Pseudo latency-budgeted inference
import time

def classify(tweet, model, classifier):
    t0 = time.time()
    emb = model.encode(tweet.text)
    pred = classifier.predict(emb)
    latency = time.time() - t0
    return pred, latency
```

## Code Example

# Python: DP-SGD sketch for federated learning
def dp_sgd_step(model, batch, noise_multiplier, l2_norm_clip):
    # Compute gradients with clipping
    grads = compute_gradients(model, batch)
    clipped_grads = clip_gradients(grads, l2_norm_clip)
    # Add noise for differential privacy
    noisy_grads = add_gaussian_noise(clipped_grads, noise_multiplier)
    return apply_gradients(model, noisy_grads)
```
